working_hours.description: Standard working hours are 9 AM to 6 PM with a 1-hour lunch break.

annual_leave.description: Employees are entitled to 20 days of paid annual leave per year.

sick_leave.description: Employees are entitled to 10 days of paid sick leave per year. Medical certificates may be required for leaves exceeding 2 consecutive days.

maternity_leave.description: Female employees are entitled to 180 days (6 months) of paid maternity leave.

paternity_leave.description: Male employees are entitled to 10 days of paid paternity leave.

casual_leave.description: Employees are entitled to 5 days of casual leave per year, typically for personal errands or emergencies.

work_from_home.description: Employees may work from home up to 3 days per week with manager approval. WFH policy promotes work-life balance while maintaining collaboration.

leaves_without_pay.description: Upon approval, employees may take unpaid leave beyond their entitled days. This requires at least 30 days notice and manager approval.
